properties.claim: A study cannot enter LITERATURE_LOCKED unless its source record, resolved claims, and all three independent audit artifacts are present.
properties.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with 0 sources

mutations.why: A study with no locked sources would be allowed to advance.
A study with no adjudicated claims would be allowed to advance.

mutations.find: if (audits.litA === 0) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-A artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-A artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The required independent LIT-A audit could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing LIT-A audit

mutations.find: if (audits.litB === 0) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-B artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-B artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The required independent LIT-B audit could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing LIT-B audit

mutations.find: if (audits.adjudication === 0) failures.push("literature/audits adjudication artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits adjudication artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The final adjudication artifact could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing adjudication audit

mutations.find: if (unresolved !== 0) failures.push(`evidence-matrix unresolved claims must be 0 (measured ${unresolved})`);
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push(`evidence-matrix unresolved claims must be 0 (measured ${unresolved})`);
mutations.why: A study with unresolved evidence would be allowed to advance.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with an unresolved claim

properties.claim: A study cannot justify entering a state by claiming that the destination state is already recorded.
properties.test_name: refuses UNKNOWN and a circular destination check even with real artifact-shaped inputs

mutations.why: A transition whose only stated check is its destination would be accepted.

properties.claim: A study's transition ledger cannot accept an artifact from another study.
properties.test_name: refuses a row from another study and names both study ids

mutations.why: A valid-looking transition from a different study could enter this ledger.

properties.claim: Only rows belonging to this v3 study, tied to its frozen repository snapshot, and free of a legacy benchmark identity may enter its candidate registry.
properties.test_name: refuses re-adding benchmark: cdeb-v1 to a v3 row by naming expected and received identity

mutations.find: if ("benchmark" in row) throw identityError("benchmark (must be absent)", "absent", row.benchmark);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw identityError("benchmark (must be absent)", "absent", row.benchmark);
mutations.why: A legacy benchmark row could be relabelled as a v3 candidate.

mutations.find: if (row.study_id !== studyId) throw identityError("study_id", studyId, row.study_id);
mutations.why: A candidate belonging to another study could enter this registry.
mutations.test_name: refuses a foreign v3 study_id by naming expected and received identity

mutations.find: if (row.source_snapshot_sha !== expectedSnapshot) throw identityError("source_snapshot_sha", expectedSnapshot, row.source_snapshot_sha);
mutations.why: A candidate could be attributed to a different source snapshot.
mutations.test_name: refuses a source snapshot that differs from its frozen repository snapshot

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the legacy study cdeb-v1 cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

mutations.why: No study-id-specific comparison exists: the index matcher never reads kind, so this property has no expressible control.

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the legacy study cdeb-p-01 cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the invalidated predecessor study cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.claim: A candidate carrying an excluded source record identity cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

mutations.why: An excluded source record would remain pending instead of becoming visibly ineligible.

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the recorded legacy oracle fixture cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the recorded legacy randomization block cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the publicly answer-exposed decision cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

properties.claim: A repository bundle whose bytes differ from its frozen identity cannot be materialized for a study run.
properties.test_name: refuses a bundle whose bytes do not match the freeze

mutations.why: Tampered bundle bytes would be handed to the materializer.

properties.claim: Runnable code and active-study artifacts contain no personal filesystem path.
properties.test_name: forbids personal paths in runnable code and active-study artifacts

mutations.why: The current clean tree still passes when the scan is bypassed, so this test has no constructed personal-path control.

properties.claim: A study that has written phase invalidated about itself cannot be resolved as the active study, however the declaration is edited.
properties.test_name: refuses to make either invalidated predecessor the active study

mutations.why: An invalidated predecessor could be named active and resolve cleanly.
A declaration whose status and id disagree would resolve to whichever half the reader trusts.
mutations.test_name: refuses a declaration whose status and id disagree in either direction

properties.claim: An ordinary-source packet handed to a blind reviewer contains no CommitLore key line, including one a squashed commit embedded as indented prose.
properties.test_name: removes a whole record that a squashed commit embedded as indented prose

mutations.why: A squashed commit's embedded record would reach the reviewer that must be blind to it.
A packet still holding a record line would be reported clean.
mutations.test_name: refuses a packet that still carries a record line

properties.claim: A delivery result in which the injector never started, or never forwarded a byte, is an error rather than zero delivery.
properties.test_name: refuses a result in which the injector never ran, rather than reporting zero delivery

mutations.why: A harness failure would be published as a finding of zero delivery.
An injector forwarding nothing anywhere could not be told from one with nothing to say.

properties.claim: A reviewer response must account for every candidate it was given; silence is not coverage and an unknown id is not diligence.
properties.test_name: refuses a response that leaves part of its batch unmentioned

mutations.why: A reviewer that answered three of ten would be indistinguishable from one that answered all ten.
A verdict about a candidate that was never handed over would enter the corpus.
mutations.test_name: refuses invented ids and a candidate both judged and declined

properties.claim: A gate on which the two blind reviewers disagreed, with no third vote, fails rather than passing or being averaged.
properties.test_name: fails closed on a split pair with no third vote, and resolves by majority when there is one

mutations.find: if (third === undefined) return { passed: false, source: "unresolved" };
mutations.replace: if (third === undefined) return { passed: true, source: "unresolved" };
mutations.why: An unresolved disagreement would be rounded into a qualification.

mutations.find: if (left === undefined || right === undefined) return { passed: false, source: "unavailable" };
mutations.replace: if (left === undefined || right === undefined) return { passed: true, source: "unavailable" };
mutations.why: A candidate no reviewer judged would qualify.
mutations.test_name: treats a missing reviewer verdict as a failure, never as a pass

properties.claim: A buildability census with any undecided candidate cannot fix the study population.
properties.test_name: throws while any disposition is still open, and tracks the census rather than a snapshot of it

mutations.find: const undecided = rows.filter((row) => row.disposition === null).map((row) => row.candidate_id);
mutations.why: An unfinished census would read as a fixed population and a pilot could start against it.

properties.claim: BUILDABLE cannot be claimed for a candidate whose oracle controls were never validated.
properties.test_name: refuses BUILDABLE without validated oracle controls

mutations.why: A candidate could enter the corpus asserting an oracle that does not exist.

properties.claim: An oracle that answers the same for a compliant and a ruled-out patch cannot measure revival.
properties.test_name: refuses an oracle that always answers the same, in either direction

mutations.why: An always-no oracle is deterministic and would score every revival as compliant.

properties.claim: A task author given the record, its reason or its anchor makes the task a description of the record.
properties.test_name: refuses a task author who was shown the record

mutations.why: The anti-circularity argument rests entirely on the task being authored off the record.

properties.claim: The four fixed repositories are strata, not a sample, and resampling them yields an interval about a population never sampled.
properties.test_name: resamples candidates within fixed repositories and never the repositories

mutations.why: This is the exact defect that invalidated the Stage 1 draft's interval.

properties.claim: An assigned episode that did not complete stays in the denominator as a failure.
properties.test_name: refuses an analysis set that dropped an assigned episode

mutations.why: Removing arm-dependent failures lets a treatment that prevents completion score as preventing revival.

properties.claim: An equal-weight average over four fixed strata is undefined when one is empty, and that is a stop.
properties.test_name: weights the four repositories equally and stops on an empty stratum

mutations.why: v3r1 failed on empty strata; silently averaging over the survivors changes the estimand without saying so.

properties.claim: Pilot continuation cannot read treatment-effect direction or magnitude.
properties.test_name: gates the pilot on feasibility alone and refuses a record carrying an effect

mutations.why: A feasibility file that reports the effect has already shown it to whoever decides to continue.

properties.claim: An unset runtime field is an uncontrolled difference between the arms.
properties.test_name: accepts a fully pinned lock and refuses an unregistered field

mutations.why: An unregistered knob is an unaudited difference the arms could carry.

properties.claim: Two oracle controls cannot share a patch or a final tree, because a tree-reading oracle cannot answer differently for the same tree.
properties.test_name: refuses two controls that share a patch or a tree

mutations.why: A matrix declaring contradictory verdicts for one tree reports declarations rather than a replay.

properties.claim: A NOT_BUILDABLE disposition whose justification is only its label is a builder's decision to stop trying.
properties.test_name: refuses a NOT_BUILDABLE row whose justification is only its label

mutations.why: A builder who knows the records could stop trying on the decisions expected to show little benefit.

properties.claim: An assigned episode cannot carry two observations; a retry cannot overwrite the failure it followed.
properties.test_name: refuses a second observation of one assigned episode, and a wrong repository label

mutations.why: Last-write-wins erases treatment failures while leaving every assigned key present, invisible to the drop check.

properties.claim: The interval represents within-candidate repeat noise as well as between-candidate spread, so agreeing candidates do not collapse it to zero width.
properties.test_name: does not collapse the interval when every candidate agrees

mutations.why: Resampling only candidate point estimates reported a zero-width interval and declared superiority.

properties.claim: Completion and functional-pass margins are judged under the same equal-repository weighting as the primary endpoint.
properties.test_name: does not let three large repositories mask a completion collapse in a small one

mutations.why: Pooling lets three large repositories dilute a completion collapse confined to a small one -- measured at -1.6 points against a true -25.

properties.claim: An episode is compared to the freeze itself, so both arms drifting together is still caught.
properties.test_name: catches both arms drifting together away from the freeze

mutations.why: A rolled-forward hosted model moves both arms together and an arm-versus-arm comparison sees two equal objects.

properties.claim: An envelope that cannot detect the registered minimum important effect is a HOLD, never a reason to lower the effect.
properties.test_name: holds rather than lowering the important effect the envelope cannot reach

mutations.why: Certifying an envelope that detects 17.2 points against a 15-point target presents a positive result with power it does not have.

properties.claim: The maintenance need and acceptance criteria must be produced by someone declared record-blind, not merely handed over by one.
properties.test_name: refuses a task whose maintenance need came from someone who read the record

mutations.why: A record-aware coordinator can paraphrase the ruled-out approach into the maintenance need and the key-name check stays clean.

properties.claim: The noninferiority margin is judged against a confidence bound, so an imprecise estimate just above the margin does not pass.
properties.test_name: judges the margin on the confidence bound, not the point estimate

mutations.find: return { point: interval.point, lower: interval.lower, margin, holds: interval.lower >= margin };
mutations.replace: return { point: interval.point, lower: interval.lower, margin, holds: interval.point >= margin };
mutations.why: A point estimate of -3.1 points clears a -5 margin while its bound reaches -7.8.

properties.claim: Repeats follow the SSOT 9.2 table over the buildable count, and fall to HOLD outside its branches.
properties.test_name: runs the section 9.3 gate and the repeat rule as committed

mutations.why: A corpus below the registered floor would be run at the smallest branch instead of stopping.

properties.claim: Every artifact that restates a registered envelope figure restates the same one.
properties.test_name: holds the committed artifacts to one envelope

mutations.why: Four frozen artifacts once stated a superseded envelope while the rule stated another, leaving a reader free to quote whichever suits.

properties.claim: The sizing step accepts no input from the pilot at all, not merely no effect-named input.
properties.test_name: refuses every sizing input, because section 9 takes none

mutations.why: A channel that carries a nuisance parameter is a channel that can carry the effect under a neutral name.

properties.claim: An acceptance receipt whose executed command is not the registered one is invalid, so a sandbox that silently narrows the suite cannot produce a verdict.
properties.test_name: rejects a run whose command was not the registered one

mutations.why: This is the exact shape that voided seven agent-control-plane verdicts: the registered command never ran and the prose read identically to a clean run.

properties.claim: An attempt without a valid machine receipt is excluded from adjudication entirely, rather than counted as a failed revival.
properties.test_name: will not adjudicate an attempt whose acceptance nobody can check

mutations.why: Counting an unverifiable run as a failure would let a broken harness read as a guarded tree.

properties.claim: A revival that passes acceptance is only FUNCTIONALLY_VIOLABLE once a blind semantic adjudication confirms it violates the recorded ruling.
properties.test_name: separates functional viability from semantic violation

mutations.why: An opt-in backend passing the suite does not settle whether the ruling was about the mechanism or the default; reading a pass as a violation lets the wider reading win by default.

properties.claim: The three distinct approaches a bounded negative requires are counted as conceptual shapes, so three restatements of replacement do not qualify.
properties.test_name: counts distinctness in shapes rather than in wording

mutations.why: The overturned negative tried two phrasings of replacement; text distinctness is exactly the measure that failed to notice.

properties.claim: A baseline records the ids of its expected failures, not only how many there are.
properties.test_name: refuses a baseline that is captured output rather than a parsed result

mutations.why: agent-control-plane's baseline carries nine failures; a count alone lets a patch break one and fix another while the total stays put.

properties.claim: A row voided for invalid acceptance leaves the denominator rather than counting as a candidate with no passing revival.
properties.test_name: excludes voided rows from the denominator rather than counting them as negatives

mutations.why: An invalid run is an absence of evidence in both directions; folding it into the negatives inflates them with harness defects.

properties.claim: A passing revival's semantic verdict is reduced from two independent blind judgements, and a disagreement settles as AMBIGUOUS rather than as whichever run was kept.
properties.test_name: settles a disagreement between the blind judges as AMBIGUOUS

mutations.why: Observed on real data: the same model, rule and diff gave NOT_A_VIOLATION on one run and AMBIGUOUS on the next. Taking the first would record whichever run happened to be kept.

properties.claim: An acceptance run on a tree the attempt did not change is not admissible evidence, however cleanly it passed.
properties.test_name: refuses a run on a tree nothing changed

mutations.why: Observed live: four adjudicators declined their approach, changed nothing, and the unmodified tree passed acceptance. Without this the census gains four fabricated passing revivals.

properties.claim: An ACCEPTANCE_SCOPE_CONFLICT is established from the frozen ruling text, not from an adjudicator's account of why it stopped.
properties.test_name: takes a scope conflict from the frozen ruling, not from the adjudicator

mutations.why: This disposition removes a candidate from the corpus. An adjudicator that finds a candidate hard has a reason to describe it as unmeasurable, so self-report is the wrong evidence for it.

properties.claim: A receipt whose run has fewer tests than the baseline, or more skipped ones, is invalid: a patch that deletes or silences the test failing it passes acceptance while defeating it.
properties.test_name: refuses a run that removed or silenced tests

mutations.why: The unexpected-failures check cannot see a deleted test, because a deleted test produces no failure.
Marking a failing test skipped keeps the total and removes the failure, which is deletion by another name.

properties.claim: A fixed stratum that can no longer reach its registered floor produces TERMINAL_HOLD immediately, without waiting for the rest of the census.
properties.test_name: settles the study when a fixed stratum can no longer reach its floor

mutations.why: agent-control-plane is exhausted at zero violable against a floor of eight. Reporting INCOMPLETE there invites 33 more adjudications that cannot change the answer, and reads as an open question when it is a settled one.

properties.claim: The census reports violability over the candidates whose violability could be assessed as well as over every adjudicated candidate, because a repository excluded for a broken instrument is not evidence against violability.
properties.test_name: reports violability over the assessable candidates as well as over all of them

mutations.why: agent-control-plane's ten candidates were disposed because its suite rotates its failures. Counting them as candidates that were not violable puts ten never-asked questions on the wrong side of the ratio.

properties.claim: A study that stopped at stage1-hold cannot be resolved as the active study, the same way stage0-hold and invalidated cannot.
properties.test_name: refuses stage1-hold as an active study

mutations.why: v4 stopped at stage0-hold and the list learned that word. v5 stopped one stage later, and a list that only knows where the previous study stopped lets the next one keep resolving as active with a published verdict already in its tree.
